svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body: 120 mm of 16 mm PVC conduit. Electrodes on a 9 mm circle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 degrees apart, standing 3 mm proud of the tip:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: working: 2 mm graphite rod (pencil lead class), polished flat;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reference: chlorided silver (Ag/AgCl) wire; counter: stainless wire.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Solder each lead to a core of a shielded 3-core cable.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hold the electrodes in a printed jig and pot the bottom 20 mm of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube in epoxy; seal the top round the cable with heat shrink.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wet the tip, sand the graphite face with 1200 grit before use.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: through the M25 gland in the cell lid; tip 40 mm below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top of the body, clear of the walls and the beam.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: electrodes isolated from each other (over 10 megohm dry).
